name: kanbot
description: Local-first Kanban board: GitHub issues in, Claude Code agents in git worktrees, pull requests out

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: npm run build -w web && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
